act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In section 479, for the words “Presidency Magistrate, District Magistrate or other
text:
78. In section 479, for the words “Presidency Magistrate, District Magistrate or other

Magistrate”, the words “Chief Judicial Magistrate or any other Judicial Magistrate” shall be
substituted.
